visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with dark curly hair, wearing a purple floral patterned shirt and a maroon-and-white striped apron, stands behind a large circular metal griddle in a bustling outdoor market. She uses a large metal spatula to flip ingredients on the steaming griddle. (2) Close-up shots follow the cooking process; batter is poured, eggs are cracked, and fresh oysters and green leafy vegetables are mixed together on the hot surface. Large bins filled with fresh eggs and oysters sit on the red table in the foreground. (3) A pair of hands presents two plates of golden-brown oyster omelets smothered in a thick, vibrant red sauce. Chopsticks lift a piece of the omelet, revealing the soft, translucent texture and the embedded oysters inside. (4) A yellow vertical menu board displays Chinese characters and prices (70, 85, 50). The scene transitions to a street view of the market with red plastic stools and tables under a permanent metal awning where a customer sits using a phone.
